response.overview: In a documentary, every image reflects the subjectivity of the one who creates it. In Una distanza siderale, Noemi Forti transforms this awareness into narration: the footage of a performance by Thomas Valerio, artist and co-writer of this film, conceals a relationship. The attention devoted to the performance coexists with the love and fear that permeate every image.
response.title: Una distanza siderale
